name: TFDi Design MD-11

flaps._comment: Do not infer SimConnect handle indexes from MD-11 flap-angle labels. On 2026-09-25 the PW4462 Low Poly Cabin reported handle index 1, handle 14.2857%, and actual angle 14.95 degrees while the cockpit showed FLAPS 15. The former table incorrectly labelled this 5. Use measured physical angle, or labelled raw percent when angle is unavailable, until all handle slots and Dial-a-Flap behavior are verified. Landing angles remain provisional family compatibility values. See docs/MD11-PROFILE-VALIDATION.md.

engines._comment: 3 engines: 2 underwing (GE CF6-80C2D1F or PW4460/4462) + 1 centre-mounted tail-cone engine. TFDi models both engine variants. EPR-based thrust management.

aircraftCfg._comment: An MD11 designator is accepted only when both the aircraft title and creator identify TFDi; bare MD11 metadata may identify traffic models or other MD-11 products.

lights._comment: Use the trusted MD-11 stable switch decoder for the overview. Live switch changes did not update the standard light mask. Missing, stale or unpowered vendor readings mark the overview unavailable. See docs/MD11-CONTROL-VALIDATION.md.

controls._comment: Guarded EXTCTL targets and CEVENT light, sign and minimums controls use the exact bundled adapter. Generic cockpit fallback remains disabled. See docs/MD11-CONTROL-VALIDATION.md for verified scope and remaining 737 coverage gaps.

meta.notes: Trusted TFDi Design MD-11 monitoring and 24 guarded aircraft-specific actions: IAS/heading/altitude targets, exterior-light buttons and detents, cabin signs, inHg pressure and RADIO-reference minimums. Uses documented EXTCTL inputs and CEVENT events, never raw state writes. Live changed-and-restored PW4462 checks, limitations and remaining 737 parity gaps: docs/MD11-CONTROL-VALIDATION.md. Earlier monitoring checks: docs/MD11-PROFILE-VALIDATION.md. Other variants and airborne operation remain unverified.

sources.notes: Documents MD11_AFS_SPD, MD11_AFS_HDG, MD11_AFS_ALT, MD11_AFS_VS, MD11_AP_STATE, MD11_ATS_STATE, MD11_ATS_CLAMP, MD11_APU_STATE, MD11_APU_N1, MD11_APU_N2, MD11_AP_IAS_MACH, MD11_AP_HDG_TRK, MD11_AP_VS_FPA, MD11_AP_FT_M, MD11_V1, MD11_VR, MD11_V2, MD11_VSR, MD11_VFR; explicit external-control inputs MD11_EXTCTL_FCP_SPD, MD11_EXTCTL_FCP_HDG, MD11_EXTCTL_FCP_ALT, MD11_EXTCTL_CAP_BARO, MD11_EXTCTL_FO_BARO; and the control/annunciator variables consumed by the adapter. sources.name: TFDi MD-11 Integration Guide Events
sources.notes: Documents the CEVENT IDs used for exterior-light press/release, landing/nose detents, cabin signs and minimums wheels. Reversible live transition evidence and event table: docs/MD11-CONTROL-VALIDATION.md.

knownIssues: The MSFS 2024 title TFDi Design MD-11 PW4462 (Low Poly Cabin) and parked readbacks were observed on 2026-09-25. Installed package version, other variants and airborne behavior remain unverified. See docs/MD11-PROFILE-VALIDATION.md.

Generic LIGHT STATES did not follow live switch changes. The overview now uses fresh, powered vendor switch selections and hides availability when these are missing. Minimums direct EXTCTL writes did not confirm, so bounded CEVENT wheel events are used. The centre-body gear has no verified separate binding.
Flap and gear operating limits remain provisional MD-11-family compatibility values until cross-checked against redistributable public-source or vendor data for the target add-on configuration.

_comment: TFDi Design MD-11 for MSFS 2020 and 2024. Payware wide-body tri-jet (Boeing Officially Licensed) with GE CF6-80C2D1F or PW4460/4462 passenger/freighter variants. The exact-profile page offers guarded core controls through documented EXTCTL inputs and CEVENT events, with independent vendor readback; it does not write raw state/control LVARs. Flap and gear speed values remain provisional pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification.
